preconditions.description: The number of elements in the set S must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= S_i <= 200000 for S_i in S)
preconditions.description: Each element in the set S must be a distinct positive integer between 1 and 200,000.
The length of the set S must match the specified number of elements n.

postconditions.description: The first line of output must be the largest non-negative integer x.
The number of integers in the magical permutation must be equal to 2 raised to the power of x.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(num) < 2**x for num in stdout.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: All integers in the magical permutation must be within the range from 0 to 2^x - 1.

postconditions.expression: all((int(stdout.split()[1:][i]) ^ int(stdout.split()[1:][i+1])) in S for i in range(len(stdout.split()[1:]) - 1))
postconditions.description: The bitwise xor of any two consecutive elements in the permutation must be an element in the set S.
